name: prometheus.scrape

arguments.name: forward_to
arguments.description: List of receivers to send scraped metrics to.

arguments.name: targets
arguments.description: List of targets to scrape.

arguments.name: bearer_token_file
arguments.description: File containing a bearer token to authenticate with.

arguments.name: bearer_token
arguments.description: Bearer token to authenticate with.

arguments.name: body_size_limit
arguments.description: An uncompressed response body larger than this many bytes causes the scrape to fail. 0 means no limit.

arguments.name: enable_http2
arguments.description: Whether HTTP2 is supported for requests.

arguments.name: enable_protobuf_negotiation
arguments.description: Deprecated: use scrape_protocols instead.

arguments.name: extra_metrics
arguments.description: Whether extra metrics should be generated for scrape targets.

arguments.name: follow_redirects
arguments.description: Whether redirects returned by the server should be followed.

arguments.name: http_headers
arguments.description: Custom HTTP headers to be sent along with each request. The map key is the header name.

arguments.name: honor_labels
arguments.description: Indicator whether the scraped metrics should remain unmodified.

arguments.name: honor_timestamps
arguments.description: Indicator whether the scraped timestamps should be respected.

arguments.name: job_name
arguments.description: The value to use for the job label if not already set.

arguments.name: label_limit
arguments.description: More than this many labels post metric-relabeling causes the scrape to fail.

arguments.name: label_name_length_limit
arguments.description: More than this label name length post metric-relabeling causes the scrape to fail.

arguments.name: label_value_length_limit
arguments.description: More than this label value length post metric-relabeling causes the scrape to fail.

arguments.name: metrics_path
arguments.description: The HTTP resource path on which to fetch metrics from targets.

arguments.name: no_proxy
arguments.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses, CIDR notations, and domain names to exclude from proxying.

arguments.name: params
arguments.description: A set of query parameters with which the target is scraped.

arguments.name: proxy_connect_header
arguments.description: Specifies headers to send to proxies during CONNECT requests.

arguments.name: proxy_from_environment
arguments.description: Use the proxy URL indicated by environment variables.

arguments.name: proxy_url
arguments.description: HTTP proxy to send requests through.

arguments.name: sample_limit
arguments.description: More than this many samples post metric-relabeling causes the scrape to fail

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.description: The URL scheme with which to fetch metrics from targets.

arguments.name: scrape_classic_histograms
arguments.description: Whether to scrape a classic histogram that’s also exposed as a native histogram.

arguments.name: scrape_failure_log_file
arguments.description: File to which scrape failures are logged.

arguments.name: scrape_interval
arguments.description: How frequently to scrape the targets of this scrape configuration.

arguments.name: scrape_native_histograms
arguments.description: Whether to scrape native histograms.

arguments.name: scrape_protocols
arguments.description: The protocols to negotiate during a scrape, in order of preference. See below for available values.

arguments.name: scrape_timeout
arguments.description: The timeout for scraping targets of this configuration.

arguments.name: target_limit
arguments.description: More than this many targets after the target relabeling causes the scrapes to fail.

arguments.name: track_timestamps_staleness
arguments.description: Indicator whether to track the staleness of the scraped timestamps.
